hook.line: Welcome back to From Scratch, where I take a concept and turn it into a full brand.
hook.visual: Presenter waving on a green sofa with a handheld mic; serif words pop up beside her one at a time, then a bold 'from scratch' title; cut to a laptop at 2.47 s.

beats.what: Wave and greeting with one keyword at a time beside her face, then the series title 'from scratch'.
Cut to hands on a laptop showing the café's brand grid from episode 1.
Brand image: 'the moody café' wordmark over red macarons.
Full-frame pink title card 'STEP 1: PROMO VIDEO'.
Fast run of short cuts (under a second each) illustrating the mood moments behind the promo.
Part two, the community street series: back on the sofa, one keyword caption above her head.
Third part named to camera: monthly 'mood drops'.
Zoom punch as she explains the café showing up at events around the city.
Event photos fan in like a stack of prints over the frame.
Wide-eyed close with 'FOLLOW FOR MORE' text and a pointer to the next episode.

characters.who: Handheld mic used as a prop
characters.enters: In her hand from the first frame
characters.acts: Held like a podcast or street-interview mic, framing the video as a show
characters.exits: Stays with her to the end

why_it_works: Series framing ('episode 2 of From Scratch') promises a continuing story, so viewers follow to see the next episode.
One keyword at a time above her head (3 words on screen median) is readable instantly and leaves the face uncluttered.
Concrete numbered steps (promo video, community, mood drops) with a title card for step 1 give a clear plan to save.
Warm, consistent set (green sofa, cream outfit) matches the café brand, so the creator is part of the moodboard.
weaknesses: The 26 s stretch on the sofa with only keyword captions is long for a 102 s video.
Only step 1 gets a title card; steps 2 and 3 are spoken only, so the structure fades.
Ends with two CTAs (follow, book a call), which splits the ask.
for_robert: Copy the one-keyword caption above the head: it keeps the frame clean enough for Fred to swim in beside Robert without fighting a caption block.
